B.domain: Subtraction of fractions and mixed numbers with simplification

skills.name: Normalize operands
skills.definition: Rewrite a quantity into a subtraction-ready equivalent form, such as simplifying a fraction part, converting an improper mixed form, rewriting a whole number with a fractional part, or converting a mixed number to an improper fraction.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step rewrites a mixed number with an improper fraction part into a standard equivalent form.
Tag when a step simplifies a fractional part before subtraction.
Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a whole plus 0 over a denominator to align parts.
Tag when a mixed number is converted to an improper fraction for fraction subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag mere problem classification statements with no mathematical transformation.
Do not tag finding a common denominator unless an operand is actually rewritten.
Do not tag the subtraction itself after forms are already aligned.

skills.name: Common denominator conversion
skills.definition: Find a least common denominator and convert unlike fractions to equivalent fractions with that denominator before subtracting.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when denominators differ and the solver finds an LCD or common denominator.
Tag when fractions are rewritten as equivalent fractions with the common denominator.
Tag for unlike fractional parts inside mixed-number subtraction as well as pure fraction subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag subtraction of fractions that already share a denominator.
Do not tag rewriting a whole number as 0 over a denominator unless the main operation is denominator matching for unlike fractions.
Do not tag simplification after subtraction.

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Subtract quantities once forms are aligned, including subtracting numerators of like fractions and subtracting whole and fractional parts of mixed numbers, then combining the result.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when like-denominator fractions are subtracted by subtracting numerators.
Tag when whole parts and fraction parts of mixed numbers are subtracted without borrowing.
Tag when the solver combines the resulting whole and fractional parts into a final mixed number or fraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag steps whose main purpose is borrowing/regrouping because the fractional part would otherwise be negative.
Do not tag denominator-conversion steps.
Do not tag simplification-only steps such as reducing 9/12 to 3/4 or 0/3 to 0.

skills.name: Borrow in subtraction
skills.definition: Regroup one whole as an equivalent fractional amount to continue subtraction when the fractional part of the minuend is smaller than the fractional part of the subtrahend.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step explicitly borrows 1 from the whole part.
Tag when the borrowed whole is converted into denominator-over-denominator and added to the fractional part.
Tag when subtraction resumes after borrowing in mixed-number or whole-minus-fraction problems.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary subtraction when no regrouping is needed.
Do not tag normalization of improper mixed forms unless borrowing is actually performed.
Do not tag final simplification after the borrowed subtraction is complete.

C.domain: Subtraction of fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with simplification

skills.name: Normalize forms
skills.definition: Rewrite a quantity into a workable equivalent form before subtracting, such as simplifying a fractional part, converting an improper mixed form, rewriting a whole number with a fractional part, or converting mixed numbers to improper fractions.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step rewrites a whole number as a whole plus 0/n.
Tag when a step simplifies a fraction inside a mixed number before subtraction.
Tag when a step normalizes a nonstandard mixed number with an improper fraction part into a standard equivalent form.
Tag when a step converts mixed numbers to improper fractions as the chosen subtraction method.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag mere problem classification statements with no mathematical rewriting.
Do not tag finding a common denominator unless an actual rewrite to equivalent fractions is performed for denominator alignment.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping after subtraction has begun.

skills.name: Align denominators
skills.definition: Find a least common denominator and rewrite fractions as equivalent fractions with that common denominator before subtraction.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution explicitly finds an LCD or common denominator.
Tag when fractions are converted to equivalent fractions to match denominators before subtracting.
Tag for both pure-fraction items and mixed-number items when denominator alignment is required.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators are already the same and no conversion is needed.
Do not tag simplification of a result after subtraction.
Do not tag conversion of mixed numbers to improper fractions if no denominator alignment is performed.

skills.name: Subtract components
skills.definition: Carry out the subtraction once forms are aligned, including subtracting numerators for like fractions or subtracting whole and fractional parts separately when no regrouping is needed.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when numerators are subtracted for fractions with the same denominator.
Tag when whole parts and fraction parts are subtracted directly in mixed-number or whole-number contexts without borrowing.
Tag when subtraction is performed after conversion to improper fractions.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag steps whose main purpose is borrowing/regrouping because the fractional part would be negative.
Do not tag final simplification or rewriting of the answer form unless actual subtraction occurs in that step.
Do not tag denominator-finding or normalization steps before subtraction.

skills.name: Regroup and simplify
skills.definition: Resolve subtraction cases that require borrowing across whole and fractional parts and express the final result in lowest terms or integer/mixed-number form.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step borrows 1 whole and converts it into n/n to continue fraction subtraction.
Tag when a negative fractional difference is repaired by regrouping from the whole part.
Tag when a non-reduced fraction or zero fraction is simplified to lowest terms or to an integer.
Tag when the final combined answer is written after regrouping or simplification changes the form.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag direct subtraction steps that do not involve borrowing or simplification.
Do not tag initial normalization before subtraction.
Do not tag common-denominator conversion unless regrouping or simplification also occurs in the tagged step.

A.domain: Subtracting fractions and mixed numbers and expressing results in lowest terms

skills.name: Normalize operands
skills.definition: Rewrite a quantity into a usable equivalent form before subtraction, such as simplifying a fraction part, converting an improper mixed form, or writing a whole number with a fractional part.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step rewrites a whole number as a whole plus 0 over a denominator, such as 3 = 3 + 0/5
Tag when a step normalizes a mixed number with an improper fraction part, such as 2 3/2 = 3 1/2
Tag when a step simplifies a non-reduced fractional part inside a mixed number before subtracting
Tag when a step converts mixed numbers to improper fractions as the chosen setup for subtraction
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary subtraction steps once the numbers are already in workable form
Do not tag finding a common denominator by scaling fractions; that belongs to denominator alignment
Do not tag borrowing from the whole part during subtraction; that belongs to regrouping

skills.name: Align denominators
skills.definition: Find a common denominator and rewrite fractions as equivalent fractions so they can be subtracted.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step finds an LCD or common denominator for unlike denominators
Tag when a step converts one or both fractions to equivalent fractions with that denominator
Tag for both pure-fraction items and mixed-number items when the fractional parts have unlike denominators
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators are already the same and no conversion is performed
Do not tag simplifying a fraction after subtraction
Do not tag rewriting a whole number as having a zero fractional part unless equivalent-fraction conversion is explicitly being done for denominator matching

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Carry out the subtraction once forms are compatible, including subtracting numerators for like fractions and subtracting whole and fractional parts of mixed numbers.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step subtracts fractions with the same denominator
Tag when a step subtracts whole parts and fraction parts of mixed numbers without borrowing
Tag when a step subtracts improper fractions after setup is complete
Tag when a step combines the resulting whole and fractional parts into the final mixed number or fraction
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag preparatory rewriting or normalization steps
Do not tag common-denominator finding and equivalent-fraction conversion
Do not tag borrowing or regrouping steps used because the fractional part would otherwise be negative
Do not tag simplification-only steps such as reducing 9/12 to 3/4 or 0/3 to 0

skills.name: Regroup and simplify
skills.definition: When needed, borrow one whole into fractional units to complete the subtraction and then reduce or rewrite the result in lowest terms, including whole-number results.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step borrows 1 from the whole part and converts it to denominator-over-denominator fractional units
Tag when a step resolves a negative fractional difference by regrouping
Tag when a step simplifies a resulting fraction to lowest terms
Tag when a step rewrites a zero-valued fraction or mixed number result as a whole number such as 0 or 1
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag straightforward subtraction when no borrowing or simplification occurs
Do not tag initial normalization of operands before subtraction
Do not tag finding a common denominator before subtraction
